title: Episode 124 Opens: Adina Beg amid Delhi’s Disorder

blocks.text: Although the older metadata lags behind, the content has already shifted into Episode 124 and away from Sukha Singh’s campaign. The page re-enters the politics of Delhi, where rival claimants and unstable alliances make every office contingent and every victory temporary.

Within that churn, Ghazi-ud-Din becomes a crucial name in the story, acting alongside Maratha interests while Najib Khan’s fortunes change. The page uses these power shifts to set up the weakened position of Adina Beg, whose future now depends on shrewd alliance rather than secure authority.

This opening matters because it makes the next episode one of political recombination rather than straightforward battle. The field is being reset for new bargains, new resentments, and a fresh configuration of Sikh and regional power.
